SpaceX is reportedly building its own ultra-optimized AI training stack completely from scratch in C.

The system is designed to run across a massive cluster of around 220,000 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs connected with ultra-fast 800G networking infrastructure.

The focus is maximum efficiency:
• heavy pipeline parallelism
• near bare-metal performance
• minimal software overhead

If successful, the custom stack could potentially make large-scale AI training more than 10x faster compared to frameworks like JAX.

The next major AI breakthroughs may come as much from infrastructure engineering as from the models themselves




Elon Musk (@elonmusk)

SpaceX has almost finished writing V1.0 of an in-house AI training stack in C that exact-maps to 220k GB300s with 800G NICs, making heavy use of pipeline parallelism and getting as close to bare metal as possible.

The potential speed improvement vs JAX for large training runs is over an order of magnitude.
